svg.title: Liver cells
svg.desc: Hepatocyte plate with polygonal cells, central nuclei, binucleation, bile canaliculi, and adjacent sinusoid. Biological basis: Hepatocytes form one- to two-cell-thick plates; apical borders create bile canaliculi while basal surfaces face fenestrated sinusoids.
